title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode5 My Ego

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I want to do no matter the cost, no matter how much trouble it causes...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There are plenty of things that I want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Win against Taiga and An just to list a couple of examples. And just the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought, “I want to see what it's like on the other side of that wall.”)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm not sure if those things really count as having an ego.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Nagi came up with a lie for An and went as far as getting all the locals to keep the truth a secret from her, all because that was what she wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga went overseas by himself to try to make his team's dream come true...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And An's dad decided to stay in Japan and open up a cafe to help the next generation grow.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all wanted to make those things happen no matter what, because of their egos.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, what is it that I want to do no matter the cost...?)
<Why the long face? Is something the matter?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<How are you?
Also, how's your training going?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, actually, I managed to complete my first task. Everyone said that I've made enough progress.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But you don't seem all that happy despite such a big accomplishment.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, the thing is...
I'm trying to master the way I sang while training to make sure that our event actually succeeds...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I told the owner of COL about what I was feeling, and she said...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she said that I should try looking for what drives mine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But, I'm having a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know that I want to see what it's like on the other side of that wall after we surpass RAD WEEKEND. But I'm not sure if that counts as having an ego...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm starting to wonder if I even have something like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ever since I was little, I never had any dreams or things that I really wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I have a dream now only because I just happened to meet An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In other words, I needed someone else's help finding a dream for me to pursue...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, if you ask me if there's anything I want to do no matter the cost, no matter how much trouble it causes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <There is something you want to do no matter what. You just haven't realized it yet, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <At your very core, there's something that drives you do to what you do.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Stressing yourself out like this isn't good for you, so why don't we go for a quick walk?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It feels like it's been so long since I just went for a stroll like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You have been spending most of your time training lately.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, how do you feel now after getting a chance to take a nice, relaxing walk?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am feeling pretty relaxed now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Which is a little odd considering how scared I was when I first wandered into this part of the city...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Ahahahaha! What are you talking about?!
You're so full of yourself!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hey, what do you say we stay out all night?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought this place seemed a little dangerous at first because everyone around here was so different from me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Right.
These were uncharted waters for the old you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. They were.
Finding myself in a place I'd never been before was so scary...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was also when I found Weekend Garage, and met An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After I'd worked up the courage to open the door, An and these other musicians all began singing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Seeing that really made my heart race.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I went up to the door, opened it and...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'm getting goosebumps...
My heart's beating so fast...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't know if this has anything to do with my ego...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I'm going to sing at the event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND, then I want to do it with this feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to feel even more excited.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to make everyone else feel more excited.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to sing with that feeling at my core.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, you all seem to be coming along nicely, so let's call things here for today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
That last song was insane!
You guys sent shivers down my spine!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: That means we've still got some work left to do. I mean, we can't let you guys hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, do your best, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You startled us!
Didn't you say you were gonna head straight home from COL?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it's getting very late...
Shouldn't you be resting at home instead?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't help but open the door after hearing all of you singing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, umm...
If it's alright with you guys...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really want to sing now after hearing all of you!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I was a little worried since she seemed pretty unsure when I left her at COL...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's do one more!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, this'll be our last song for today. Let's give it everything we've got.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because you've never once run away from your feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She's right...
I was put to the test over and over along the way, but I'm standing here right now because I kept trying.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just one week to go. Do your best.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, now we're on the same page, let's do one more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
Ending practice this early feels kinda weird.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what you mean.
It's been a while since we've been practicing so late each day.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I hope I can get some sleep tonight.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I was going to poke fun at you for that, but I totally feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is the wall of all walls for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I'm excited since it's finally happening.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member A
rows.Line: Haha. But we feel ready now thanks to you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Still, it's sad that we're down one person...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: We gotta make this event so good that he's gonna really regret not coming back to do it with us!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Then, he might become so frustrated that he won't have any other choice but to come back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You look like you still haven't given up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I haven't...
I still want us to take on this challenge together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But he has to make his own decisions.
There's nothing we can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we'll be carrying his dream with us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His dream of those two surpassing that night together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Regardless, we've done everything we possibly can. There's no two ways about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All that's left is for us to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
How about you, Azusawa?
I know you have nerves of steel, but are you feeling anxious at all?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because we find out tomorrow whether or not we're able to surpass RAD WEEKEND... It's a terrifying prospect...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also can't wait for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't wait to put on the best event ever with all of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's do it! Let's put on the best event this neighborhood's ever seen! It's gonna be the greatest night ever! Completely new and unprecedented!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And after we do, we're not gonna know what to do with ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, it's probably gonna feel a hundred times better than cruising down the coast on my motorcycle.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Totally!
Or it'll be like eating all the good food you'll ever have all at once... No, better than that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm excited just thinking about tomorrow.
